observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon EOS RP camera body resting on its retail box.
The box is clearly labeled 'Canon EOS RP' and 'Digital Camera'.
Two batteries and a battery charger are visible next to the camera.
The camera body has a textured grip and a rear LCD screen.
The background shows a car hood and a building roof, suggesting an outdoor setting.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the camera and box labeled EOS RP
The photo shows the exterior; internal condition and functionality are not shown.
No photos of the sensor, shutter, or the camera powered on are provided.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the sensor may be dirty or scratched.
risks.proof: A video of the camera powering on and a clear photo of the sensor with the lens removed.

risks.risk: The shutter may be near its end of life.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent image file.

risks.risk: The battery may be degraded or the charger faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera charging and holding a charge.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed.
Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the rear LCD screen while the camera is powered on.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
